blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Agricultural damage from El Niño has climbed to almost P10 billion, the Department of Agriculture (DA) said Wednesday. In its latest advisory, the agency reported that the prolonged dry spell damaged P9.99 billion worth of farm produce, up from P8.57 billion in losses recorded on Oct. 21. READ: Agri dep’t eyes P 45-B El Niño subsidy budget El Niño has affected the livelihood of 324,327 farmers in various regions. These are Cordillera, Ilocos Region, Cagayan Valley, Central Luzon, CALABARZON, MIMAROPA, Bicol Region, Western Visayas, Negros Island Region, Central Visayas, Eastern Visayas, Zamboanga Peninsula, Northern Mindanao, Davao Region, SOCCSKSARGEN, and […]...
